items.source: Invoked after converting a Neo4j record (aka after hydrating an entity).
items.translation: 在将 Neo4j 记录（即实体水合）转换后调用。

items.source:
There is no reactive variant for this callback. It is safe to use this one for both
reactive and imperative workloads.
items.translation: 此回调没有反应式变体。对于反应式和命令式工作负载，使用此版本都是安全的。

items.source: instance - the instance as hydrated by the Neo4jEntityConverter.
items.translation: instance - 由 Neo4jEntityConverter 水合后的实例。

items.source: T - the type of the entity
source - the Neo4j record that was used to hydrate the instance
items.translation: source - 用于填充该实例的 Neo4j 记录

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。

items.source: A callback that can be used to modify an instance of a Neo4jPersistentEntity after it has been converted: That is, when a Neo4j record has been fully processed and the entity and all its associations have been processed.
items.translation: 一个回调，可用于在将 Neo4jPersistentEntity 实例转换后进行修改：即当 Neo4j 记录已完全处理，且实体及其所有关联均已处理完毕时。
